title: Predicate for an odd-weight partial-sum check
statement: For each natural number $m$, associate a linear predicate to a seed in the disjoint union of a Boolean flag and $m$ indices: the flag $\mathrm{false}$ gives a three-variable equation with right-hand side $0$; the flag $\mathrm{true}$ gives a one-variable equation with right-hand side $1$; and any index seed gives a three-variable equation with right-hand side $0$.
hypotheses_covered: the seed is either a Boolean flag or one of $m$ indices
